claims.claim: Digest-bound execution of selected source numerical cells identifies count-mass, snapshot aliasing and process-separation differences.
claims.source_role: Preserved preprint v1 and notebook implementation
claims.evidence_ceiling: A seeded numerical adapter of selected original cells, not full Colab or journal-version replication.
claims.prohibited_inference: The original paper's theory is disproved, or source behavior necessarily matches every published version.
claims.future_evidence: Author-confirmed version correspondence and independent replication of each complete original execution environment.
claims.boundary_stressor: The source Yarbus action-first B layout is valid and must not be reported as a transition defect.

claims.claim: The corrected model compares recall conditions under identical exogenous exposure and dose-matched replay.
claims.evidence_ceiling: Finite artificial stationary worlds and independent simulation streams.
claims.prohibited_inference: Agents are human participants or synthetic sample size establishes human efficacy.
claims.future_evidence: Behavioral data, parameter recovery, competing mechanisms and held-out empirical predictions.
claims.boundary_stressor: World-dependent improvements and harms to predictive loss remain reportable results.

claims.claim: Paired fixed-grid estimates retain three interval procedures, explicit studentized failures, the original Holm family and finite Monte Carlo uncertainty.
claims.source_role: Statistical methodology and independent seeded agent rows
claims.evidence_ceiling: Conditional estimands over a fixed world grid; sign-flip inference assumes null symmetry.
claims.prohibited_inference: A p-value validates the model or establishes a population effect of gratitude.
claims.future_evidence: Empirical sampling design and uncertainty analyses under plausible misspecification.
claims.boundary_stressor: Exact ties, constant nonzero effects, mismatched pairs and unresolved Monte Carlo decisions.

claims.claim: Missing evidence and an observed absence have distinct posterior consequences under explicitly declared likelihoods.
claims.source_role: New absence model and imported Realizing Emptiness comparators
claims.evidence_ceiling: Finite information and valuation operations with a declared missingness convention.
claims.prohibited_inference: Absence is always informative, undetected harm is safe, or label invariance is contemplative realization.
claims.future_evidence: Operational human tasks distinguishing missingness, verified absence and counterfactual reference effects.
claims.boundary_stressor: Uninformative likelihood, zero reference hazard, invalid probabilities and consistent state-label permutations.

claims.claim: The absence-valuation condition changes a declared value while preserving the no-recall belief path exactly.
claims.evidence_ceiling: Equality is designed into the mechanism rather than discovered in people.
claims.prohibited_inference: Human gratitude can be increased without belief change or all neutral events mean avoided harm.
claims.future_evidence: Independent valuation and belief measures, manipulation checks and alternative outcome coding.
claims.boundary_stressor: Zero reference hazard or zero harm cost removes the value without changing evidence.

claims.claim: Exogenous agent precision profiles produce different policy probabilities in a separately held-fixed process.
claims.source_role: Source-inspired extension with real GNN and pymdp execution
claims.evidence_ceiling: Model policy probabilities over a short declared scene; native executor qualification uses matched agent/process A.
claims.prohibited_inference: Measured gaze, neural implementation or learned transfer from gratitude practice.
claims.future_evidence: A learned cross-task bridge and pre/post behavioral eye-tracking under controlled exposure.
claims.boundary_stressor: Actual preference and initial-prior perturbations must change their corresponding numerical receipts.

claims.claim: Six known-answer mathematical fixtures report rejection, coverage success and interval availability with exact binomial uncertainty.
claims.source_role: Independent symmetric, skewed, heavy-tail, heterogeneous and discrete fixtures with GNN-declared budgets
claims.evidence_ceiling: Operating characteristics for each stated distribution; skew/discrete fixtures violate sign symmetry.
claims.prohibited_inference: Human clinical power, universal coverage or absence of false positives.
claims.future_evidence: Empirically constrained variability, dependence, broader misspecification and externally replicated procedures.
claims.boundary_stressor: Zero-variance studentization remains unavailable; failures and undercoverage cannot be dropped or tuned away.

claims.claim: Every sensitivity grid cell consumes a separately re-admitted GNN declaration.
claims.evidence_ceiling: Conditional sensitivity with shared seeds across cells.
claims.prohibited_inference: Grid cells are additional independent evidence or exhaust plausible human mechanisms.
claims.future_evidence: Broader generative-process misspecification, changing worlds and empirically constrained parameters.
claims.boundary_stressor: Edited model parameters must alter source hashes and numerical inputs; malformed probabilities must fail admission.

claims.claim: Exploratory world-specific paired estimates expose conditional variation and dependence on world weights.
claims.source_role: New diagnostics over admitted paired agent rows
claims.evidence_ceiling: Pointwise exploratory intervals and weighting scenarios conditional on fixed stratum estimates.
claims.prohibited_inference: Unadjusted subgroup significance, weighting ranges as confidence intervals, or transport to human populations.
claims.future_evidence: Prospective empirical estimands, justified world weights, reliability diagnostics and independent data.
claims.boundary_stressor: Opposite world signs, zero-variance intervals and undefined leave-one-out targets with one world.

claims.claim: A separately declared finite experiment distinguishes value of examinability, costly chosen inquiry, effective access, conditional model revision and independent prediction.
claims.source_role: New enacted mechanism informed by the emptiness source and real imported structural/VFE interfaces
claims.evidence_ceiling: Authored candidate repertoire and two context schedules; exploratory paired replicate estimates, not a fitted human gratitude or realization model.
claims.prohibited_inference: More activity, lower precision, an open family or a predictive gain constitutes realization of emptiness or universal benefit.
claims.future_evidence: Construct and process validation, competing behavioral models, access manipulation, independent empirical prediction and philosophical/phenomenological argument.
claims.boundary_stressor: Useful restrictions must survive; ties retain them; sham and blocked access can incur costs while preserving rigid forecasts exactly.

claims.prohibited_inference: Upstream metadata is an enacted practice protocol, in-sample diagnostics are held-out validation, or imported software establishes attainment.

claims.claim: Every practice calibration count yields a source-bound evidence decision and exact conditional selection probability; expected predictive losses retain rare and adverse outcomes.

claims.evidence_ceiling: An original-SE-standardized single-step empirical-bootstrap approximation over 58 fixed exploratory contrasts; conditional quantile Monte Carlo precision is separate from sampling coverage.
